hotel_name: The Langley, A Luxury Collection Hotel

claims.text: The hotel is set in the former manor home of the third Duke of Marlborough.

findings.quote: Beautifully situated in the former manor home of the third Duke of Marlborough

claims.text: Rooms and suites are in the sensitively restored Palladian-style mansion house and the adjoining Grade II-listed Brew House.

findings.quote: Sensitively restored, the Palladian-style mansion house and adjoining Grade-II listed Brew House offer 41 sumptuous guestrooms and suites.

claims.text: The rooms and suites were designed by Dennis Irvine studio.

findings.quote: rooms and suites, designed by Dennis Irvine studio

claims.text: Baroque fireplaces and ornate doorways have been re-established in the main house.

findings.quote: Baroque fireplaces and ornate doorways have been painstakingly re-established in the main house.

claims.text: Rooms in the Brew House, a Grade II-listed outbuilding, reflect former owners who brewed their own ferments.

findings.quote: In the Grade II listed outbuilding, the Brew House, characterful rooms reflect the playful nature of former owners who brewed their own ferments.

claims.text: The hotel has an indoor and an outdoor pool, a thermal area and fitness programs.

findings.quote: along with an indoor and outdoor pool, a thermal area, fitness programs, and healthful dining selections

claims.text: Each room includes access to the spa thermal facilities and gym.

findings.quote: Each room in our Buckinghamshire accommodation includes access to our spa thermal facilities and gym

claims.text: The spa has authentic hammams where body rituals are performed.

findings.quote: Discover our range of body rituals performed in our authentic Hammams.

claims.text: Cedar, the fine-dining restaurant, serves European cuisine with Spanish, French and Italian influences, using ingredients from local suppliers.

findings.quote: Cedar at The Langley captures the spirit of European cuisine, featuring many influences from Spain, France and the best of Italian flavours at its heart.
All ingredients in our fine-dining restaurant in Buckinghamshire are sourced from local suppliers.

claims.text: Afternoon tea is served in the Drawing Room; it and Cedar have terraces overlooking the lake and estate grounds.

findings.quote: quintessential afternoon tea is served in the exquisite Drawing Room. Both offer elegant outdoor settings, with terraces that overlook the sparkling lake and estate grounds

claims.text: Connecting rooms and suites suit families, with children's robes, slippers and bathroom amenities.

findings.quote: Relax into our expansive connecting rooms and suites, perfect for families including children's robes, slippers and bathroom amenities.

claims.text: The Duke of Marlborough Suite, the former room of the third Duke, overlooks the grounds and the lake, with an adjoining living room, three bedrooms and Athenian marble bathrooms.

findings.quote: Overlooking the grounds and the lake, the Duke of Marlborough Suite comprises a prestigious adjoining living room, three beautifully presented bedrooms, and Athenian marble bathrooms.
The former room of the third Duke of Marlborough has been transformed to a luxurious signature suite

claims.text: The Grade II-listed gardens were re-designed in the 18th century by Lancelot 'Capability' Brown.

findings.quote: The Grade II-listed gardens were re-designed in the 18th century by Lancelot ‘Capability’ Brown.

claims.text: The spa's private VIP Suite has a relaxation space, vitality pool, juniper sauna and amethyst crystal steam room.

findings.quote: Offering the utmost privacy, escape to this tranquil oasis, complete with a relaxation space, vitality pool, juniper sauna and amethyst crystal steam room

claims.text: Rooms feature roll-top baths, and expansive suites have grand windows.

findings.quote: Dignified roll-top baths steal the show and expansive suites with grand windows frame the picturesque

claims.text: Through expert partners, the concierge can arrange falconry, horse riding in Windsor Great Park and polo lessons.

findings.quote: Discover quintessentially English activities in the countryside, from falconry on an English estate, to horse riding in Windsor Great Park and learning how to play polo.
Our expert partners can create a bespoke itinerary to fit individuals, groups and families. Contact our Concierge team for more details.

claims.text: The hotel is in Langley Park in the Buckinghamshire countryside, a short car or train journey from central London rather than in the city itself.

findings.quote: All things slow and natural beauty bounds in the heart of the Buckinghamshire countryside. Look out to the picuresque surroundings of Langley Park, all found within a short car or train journey from central London.

claims.text: Rooms are split between the Main House, with restored Baroque fireplaces, and the Brew House outbuilding, which has its own character.
